faqs.a:
Revenues for the capital improvements fund may include any of the following: Appropriations
               to the capital improvements fund from the general fund; council authorized transfers
               of general fund surpluses; council authorized transfers of general obligation bond
               sale receipts; funds provided by federal, state, or county reimbursement grants, including
               county open space funds; interest on the fund investments; council authorized transfers
               from any appropriated fund of the city, including but not limited to enterprise funds,
               and any other source which the city council authorizes.
(Code 1981, § 2-68; Ord. No. 2547, § 1, 8-15-1988)
Charter reference—
Capital improvements fund, §
10.7
